LetScope range covers bindings+body; LambdaScope covers params+body; RecScope covers the attrset. WithScope covers body only.
21tttp|- Nix subtlety for let sequentiality: a let binding's VALUE must resolve against earlier bindings + outer scopes only. Implement visibility as: for scope of kind Let, a binding at index i is visible only at offsets > end of binding i's value expr (and < end of scope).
